summary: Kamiji territory (Lomami province), a rural territory between Mwene-Ditu and the Kasai-Central/Kasai-Oriental borders, has no known armed-group territorial control. The Kamuina Nsapu insurgency affected the wider Kasai and Lomami region in 2016-2017 but was suppressed by 2018 without leaving lasting militia control in Kamiji. The territorial centre (Kamiji, around Tshisangu) hosts the territorial administration and a PNC commissariat; villages are run by customary chiefs with PNC posts. Live web research was unavailable in this run (search budget exhausted), so the assessment relies on background knowledge and the default-state-presence rule, with limited confidence.

zones.evidence: Seat of Kamiji territory with territorial administrator and PNC territorial commissariat; no reports of armed-group presence after the Kamuina Nsapu crisis faded in 2017-2018.

zones.description: Rural villages of Kamiji territory (Kamiji, Lubondaie and Cilundu health zones)
zones.evidence: Villages with no reported armed-group activity; order maintained by customary chiefs and PNC posts. Residual insecurity limited to banditry and local disputes.
